title: So Close
joke: A runner on a minimum-payments treadmill chases a debt free sign bolted to the treadmill itself.
caption:
Notice where the sign is bolted on. That's the whole problem.
When payments mostly cover interest, the balance barely moves, so the finish line moves with you.
What finally got your balance moving?
